title: 7 Marks of a Brother Who'll Actually Tell You the Truth
caption:
7 marks of a brother who'll actually tell you the truth. Not the guy who just agrees with you.

He asks the follow-up question. He remembers what you confessed last month. He tells you when you're wrong, even when it costs him the comfortable version of the friendship.

Proverbs 27:6: faithful are the wounds of a friend. He stays after the apology, once the wound's done its work.
